title: 1979 AHSME Problem 25
statement: If \(q_1(x)\) and \(r_1\) are the quotient and remainder, respectively, when the polynomial \(x^8\) is divided by \(x+\frac12,\) and if \(q_2(x)\) and \(r_2\) are the quotient and remainder, respectively, when \(q_1(x)\) is divided by \(x+\frac12,\) then \(r_2\) equals

solutions.text:
Let \(a=-\frac{1}{2}.\) Since the first remainder is \(a^8,\) \[ \begin{aligned} q_1(x)&=\frac{x^8-a^8}{x-a}\\ &=x^7+ax^6+\cdots+a^7. \end{aligned} \] Therefore the second remainder is \[ \begin{aligned} q_1(a)&=8a^7\\ &=8(-\frac{1}{2})^7\\ &=-\frac{1}{16}. \end{aligned} \]

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let \(a=-\frac12\) and express the first quotient using \(x^8-a^8\)
Apply the remainder theorem to \(q_1(x)\) at \(x=a\)
